projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Here you can find a selection of the **projects** I have worked on.

reasy.description: An all-in-one online generator for secure passwords, UUIDs, color palettes, numbers and names. I'm building it with Next.js and MySQL to bring small tools that are usually scattered across different sites into a single fast, clean interface.

cardbit.description: Cardbit generates smart flashcards from videos, documents or notes, turning complex information into simple, clear cards. The perfect tool for students and professionals who want to memorize more easily and make studying truly effective.

quizzly.description: A web app for creating interactive quizzes to share on social media. I'm building it with Next.js and MySQL, integrating the OpenAI API to help generate questions and answers in seconds.
